status: Exploratory dynamic stepping evidence; walking is not validated.
interpretation: The base completes its 20-second 0.20-Nm trial but falls in the longer trial; every 30-second case terminates on a nonfoot floor contact.
The final optional tail can extend this narrowly tuned controller run when wagging, but the run still ends in a fall and includes hip-roll soft-limit overshoot and simplified-link self-contact.
All lower-cap 0.10/0.15-Nm cases fail before producing a qualifying support alternation. The controller is not robust to actuator-cap or mass-distribution changes.
RMS torque, peak speed, saturation and actual joint-limit violations must be assessed together. None establishes continuous physical motor duty, current draw or hardware feasibility.
This manual diagnostic is not a passing walking gate in CI. Static balance/build checks are separate.

protocol.scope: Manual ideal-actuator stepping diagnostic, not walking certification or physical motor/thermal validation. Flat floor and nominal mass. Starts home; no external support/forces or root resets during a run. Torque-speed curves, transmission compliance, power supply limits and disturbances are not modeled.
protocol.feedback_scope: Exact MuJoCo torso orientation and noiseless body gyro are privileged feedback. Hardware would need a matching IMU orientation estimate and independently validated noise, latency and control behavior. This is not a deployable hardware controller. Contact and clearance measurements only score results.
protocol.replay_randomness: None: fixed parameters and home state, no random sampling.
protocol.support_event_definition: After 2s: stance normal force>half bodyweight, swing normal force<.05N, minimum swing sole height>2mm, torso tilt<.52rad, no nonfoot floor contact, sustained>=40ms. Counts side changes between qualifying segments. Positive forward displacement does not by itself constitute stepping.
protocol.stop_conditions: Nonfoot floor force>.1N, torso tilt>1.05rad, root height<.065m, numerical warning/nonfinite state, or requested duration. Internal contacts are reported but do not stop the run.
protocol.measurement_scope: Torques, speeds and clearance peaks cover the full run, including a fall. Contact and geometry data are from the last physics solve; integrated joint positions can be one timestep later. Actuator force and speed arrays follow actuator_names. Saturation means >=95% of the run's torque cap. Self-contact geometry is simplified and cannot validate detailed CAD interference.

baseline_provenance_note: The 20-second baseline was rerun after the final torque-limit and world-weld guards; every measured result exactly matches the original 20-second trial. Longer baseline and optional-tail trials retain their original execution-time controller hashes on each trial. The final replay script adds loading/provenance and safety guards without changing selected targets, feedback or scoring thresholds. Longer trials were not rerun after those non-policy edits.
